# Agentforce / GenAI Reference Index — captured 2026-07-08

APIs: Agent API, Models API (Apex + REST), Testing API, Citations API, Metadata API, Tooling API.
SDKs: Agentforce Python SDK, Agentforce Mobile SDK (iOS/Android).
Other: Agent Script (agent-building language, GA), Agentforce DX (pro-code),
Lightning Types Reference, Metadata Types, Tooling Objects.

Reference index page body UNCHANGED (same surface as prior fetches). Items below via WebSearch.

Summer '26 (via WebSearch) [REPORTED 2026-07-06]: A2A open-protocol support;
API v67.0 defaults SOQL/SOSL/DML to user mode + Apex "with sharing"; Named Query API GA;
Agent Builder API; Salesforce-hosted MCP servers GA.

Commerce agents (Shopper/Buyer/Merchant) GA + ChatGPT catalog sync + Google/Gemini [REPORTED 2026-07-07].

NEW this scan 2026-07-08 (Summer '26 dev release, previously MISSED by scans):
- Headless 360 — every major Salesforce capability exposed as API / MCP tool / CLI command
  to any authenticated caller (app, human, or autonomous agent). 60+ NEW MCP tools, 30+
  coding skills. Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers (standard + custom) connect external MCP
  clients (Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor/custom agents) to org data. Custom servers buildable from
  Apex Actions, Flows, Apex REST, AuraEnabled methods, Named Query API, Prompt Builder,
  Agentforce agents, API Catalog. [MAJOR new access/API surface]
- Agent Skills — lightweight open format to extend agents w/ specialized knowledge/workflows;
  open-sourced dev skill library (npx skills add forcedotcom/sf-skills), Claude Code compatible.
- New MCP servers: Salesforce DX MCP (Beta), Metadata API Context MCP (Beta),
  Data 360 MCP (Dev Preview), Omnistudio MCP (Beta), B2C DX MCP, Marketing Cloud Engagement MCP (GA).
